statement.p: A car is driven at a speed that is initially high and then decreases, starting at noon. Which of the following could be a graph of the distance the car has traveled as a function of time past noon?

image.shortdescription: a graph of a horizontal line with positive y-intercept
a graph of a line with positive slope through the origin
a graph of a concave down curve that starts at the origin, increases and then decreases
a graph of a line with negative slope and positive y-intercept
a graph of a curve with positive, decreasing slope starting at the origin
a graph of a curve with a positive increasing slope starting at the origin
a graph of a curve with negative, increasing(ly less negative) slope
a graph of a curve with negative, decreasing slope starting on the positive y-axis

solution.p: Because the car is driven at a decreasing speed, the distance traveled for different time intervals of the same length must decrease as time goes on. Therefore the slope of the graph of distance traveled must decrease with increasing time, and must be 5.
